title.en: Active Mobility (Footpaths — Temporary Discontinuation) (Trifactor Triathlon & Duathlon) Order 2026

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Active Mobility (Footpaths — Temporary Discontinuation) (Trifactor Triathlon & Duathlon) Order 2026.
2. The footpath delineated by the black‑coloured line in the map set out in the Schedule is temporarily discontinued as a footpath from 6 a.m. to 12 noon on 13 September 2026.
